responsibility: Implements the early and late intraprocedural Scalar Replacement of Aggregates passes. It finds scalarizable aggregate candidates, records and groups accesses by offset/size, rejects problematic overlap or escape patterns, propagates access structure across assignments, chooses replacement subfields, rewrites loads/stores/calls/returns/asm operands to scalar temporaries, initializes scalarized parameters, and updates EH/CFG/SSA state so later scalar optimizers can work on former aggregate components independently.
same_name_distinction: Implements the actual intraprocedural SRA passes, from candidate/access analysis through aggregate-to-scalar rewriting and pass registration for early and late SRA. Unlike gcc/tree-sra.h, which provides only small policy/helper predicates such as layout restrictions and va_list detection, this file performs scalarization.
